senses.gloss:
उत्खचित उत्-खचित, अस्, आ, अम्, intermixed
with.

उत्खन् उत्-खन् (उद्-ख्˚), cl. 1. P. A. -ख-
नति, -ते, -नितुम्, to dig up or out, to excavate; to
tear out by the roots, root up; to draw or tear out;
to destroy entirely.

उत्-खात, अस्, आ, अम्, dug up; excavated, eradicated,
pulled up by the roots; destroyed, annihilated; (अम्),
n. a hole, a cavity, a deepening, uneven ground.

उत्खातिन्, ई, इनी, इ, having cavities or holes, un-
even; destructive.

उत्खरिन् उत्-खरिन्, ई, m., N. of a deity;
(a various reading has उत्कलि.)

उत्खला उत्खला, f. (fr. उद् and खल?), a
kind of perfume.

उत्खिद् उत्-खिद् (उद्-ख्˚), cl. 6. P. -खिन्दति
(Ved. -खिदति), -खेत्तुम्, to draw out, extract.
